capabilities: Compute CVSS 3.1 base scores from all 8 metrics in a modal
Copy the CVSS vector string to the clipboard
Insert score and vector into the note at the cursor
Update CVSS frontmatter properties of open or current findings
Fuzzy-search open findings to update their CVSS values
extras: The plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The finding-search feature filters on notes whose frontmatter has stato or status set to aperto or open, suggesting the author's Italian-language workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to calculate CVSS 3.1 scores, so users who document vulnerabilities must compute them elsewhere and paste results manually.
summary: Popup calculator that computes CVSS 3.1 base scores interactively and can insert the score and vector string into notes or frontmatter.
